stages.name: Continental Collision
stages.description: The continental plates collide, pushing magma upward.

stages.name: Solid Quartz Diorite
stages.description: Magma cools and solidifies into quartz diorite.

stages.name: Cracked Slab of Diorite
stages.description: Tectonic stress cracks the solid rock slab.

stages.name: Rounded Boulders
stages.description: Erosion rounds the sharp edges into boulders.

stages.name: Final Boulder
stages.description: The final boulder form, shaped by millions of years of geological forces.
